description: Minimal rule knowledge pack for Wolong Agent

rules.title: No absolute compliance commitment
rules.content: Do not give absolute compliance or import approval commitments when only preliminary analysis is available.

rules.title: Emotion-aware response downgrade
rules.content: When customer emotion becomes tense or unstable, downgrade aggressive business push and prefer calmer wording or collaboration support.

rules.title: Delegation remains whitelist-first
rules.content: Automatic external sending remains under whitelist-first, low-risk-first, stage-aware governance.
